title: The squat: what it REALLY works (and the knee myth) 🦵
caption:
Quads, glutes and adductors. And the 'knees never past your toes' rule? Stopping it just moves the strain to your hips. Have you heard this myth? 👇

Exercise Series, Part 1
first_comment: Back squat, front squat or goblet squat: which is your go-to? 🏋️
sources: Fry AC, Smith JC, Schilling BK. Effect of knee position on hip and knee torques during the barbell squat. J Strength Cond Res 2003;17:629-633 (restricting knee travel: hip torque +1070%, knee torque -22%, more forward lean)
Schoenfeld BJ. Squatting kinematics and kinetics and their application to exercise performance. J Strength Cond Res 2010;24:3497-3506 (muscles used; knees past toes acceptable for most)
Clark DR et al. Muscle activation in the loaded free barbell squat: a brief review. J Strength Cond Res 2012;26:1169-1178
